issue_context.title: lightning: checkpoint support s3
issue_context.body:
## Enhancement
meet requirements about dm support s3 [4360](https://github.com/pingcap/tiflow/issues/4360), lightning's checkpoint need support s3.

review_comments: what if filename returned by `separateCompletePath` is empty string. Shall we avoid this by return an error directly?
yes, i will add check empty fileName.

Amazon s3 provide `atomic write` model by default, which means we needn't use then same `write tamp file and then rename` to simulate this action. See: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonS3/latest/userguide/Welcome.html#ConsistencyModel

I suggest change the `Write` method to provide this atomic write semantics instead of add a new Rename method.

BTW, please also implement the new added method for both gcs and azure, we may also need them in the cloud environment.
ok, i will add a new method.

i add `AtomicWriteFile` and still retain `Rename` which will be called at [MoveCheckpoints](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/32373/files#diff-7d40aa2e5bde3e5085eb8b6c10b02f79b0aa0942b932b834e1faea56722ced9eR1584).
